beats.say: This is the AI Readiness Checklist. It checks whether your team, data, tools and guardrails are ready for AI work, and gives you your next three moves.
Name the check, for example by team and month.
beats.label: Name it

beats.say: Answer twenty-four statements in six areas, for your team as it is today: yes, partly, no, or not sure. Be honest: a no is more useful than a hopeful yes. Fill in an example to see it.
beats.label: 1 · Answer the statements

beats.say: Where you are shows your readiness score and what it means.
beats.label: Where you are

beats.say: The AI adoption journey shows your stage, from starting with you to organization-wide capability, and a score for each area.
beats.label: 2 · Your journey

beats.say: Your next three moves come from the gaps in your weakest areas first, with what you said that led to each.
beats.label: 3 · Next three moves

beats.say: Save it, share a link, or export it, or download the Excel version. Answer it together, act on one move at a time, and re-run it each quarter. That's the tour.
beats.label: Save, share, export
